title: 3 Kinds of People Allah Loves
_accuracy: Every point is an explicit Qur'anic statement of Allah's love (inna Allāha yuḥibb…). Arabic on the ayah beat is pulled live from Quran.com (Uthmani), never hand-typed. Copyright-clean: NO reciter recording — the narrator reads the meaning while the Arabic is shown on screen. Verify the render before publishing.
_visuals: B-roll queries are nature / sky / architecture only — no people, no faces, no human depictions.

beats.say: Allah named the exact people He loves. Not a guess. It's written in the Quran.
Three kinds of people, named by your Creator. So ask yourself — are you one of them?
Number one. The ones who always come back. They slip. They fall. But they never stay down. Every time, they return to Him.
Number two. The ones who stay fair. Even when lying is easier. Even when the truth costs them everything.
Number three. The ones who quietly do good. No audience. No credit. They give, and expect nothing back.
And listen to how Allah describes them.
Those who give in ease and in hardship. Who swallow their anger. And who pardon people. Allah loves those who do good.
So which one will you become? Save this reminder, and follow for more.

sources: Qur'an 2:222 — 'Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves.'
Qur'an 60:8 (also 49:9) — 'Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.'
Qur'an 2:195 (also 3:134) — 'And do good; indeed, Allah loves the doers of good.'
Qur'an 3:134 — 'Who spend during ease and hardship, and restrain anger, and pardon the people — and Allah loves the doers of good.'
